phase2.transform_text: 巨鼠之王發出刺耳尖嘯，狂亂地揮舞利爪衝向你！
phase2.transform_text_en: The King Rat lets out a piercing shriek, slashing wildly with its claws as it charges at you!

phase2.transform_text: 骸骨騎士眼窩中燃起幽綠火焰，怨念瞬間爆發！
phase2.transform_text_en: Ghostly green flames ignite in the Skeleton Knight's empty sockets as centuries of resentment burst forth!

phase2.transform_text: 獸人軍閥怒擲斷裂的軍旗，獨自殺入戰場！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Orc Warlord hurls down his shattered banner and charges alone into the fray!

phase2.transform_text: 深淵統治者的軀體崩解又重組，化作更純粹的災厄之形！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Abyss Sovereign's body crumbles and reforms, taking on a purer shape of calamity!

phase2.transform_text: 薩格拉斯仰天長嘯，混沌之力撕裂了他的軀殼——魔王的真正面目顯現了！
phase2.transform_text_en: Sargeras roars to the heavens as the power of chaos tears his shell apart — the Demon Lord's true form is revealed!

phase2.transform_text: 哥布林首領嗜血的雙眼發紅，舉起武器怒吼！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Goblin Chief's bloodshot eyes flare red as he raises his weapon and roars!

phase2.transform_text: 迷霧林王身上的藤蔓暴漲，化作猛獸般的姿態！
phase2.transform_text_en: The vines covering the Mistwood King surge and swell, twisting him into a beastlike form!

phase2.transform_text: 劇毒蜂后散發出濃烈的毒霾，瘋狂地振翅衝來！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Venomous Bee Queen exudes a thick cloud of poisonous miasma, charging in a frenzied flurry of wings!

phase2.transform_text: 瘋狂博士打下最後一管藥劇，全身肌肉瞬間暴漲！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Mad Doctor slams down the last vial, and his muscles surge and swell in an instant!

phase2.transform_text: 亡靈巫妖的法袍化作骷髏之風，墓地裡的亡靈紛紛甦醒共鳴！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Undead Lich's robes billow into a skeletal wind, and the dead across the graveyard stir and rise in resonance!

phase2.transform_text: 吸血鬼真祖捨棄了人形的偽裝，化作純粹的嗜血怪物！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Vampire Progenitor casts aside its human disguise, transforming into a creature of pure bloodlust!

phase2.transform_text: 遠古炎龍的逆鱗被觸怒了！鱗片間迸發出熔岩般的光芒，整座峽谷都在燃燒！
phase2.transform_text_en: You have struck the Ancient Dragon's reverse scale! Molten light erupts between its scales as the entire gorge ignites!

phase2.transform_text: 虛空主宰的身軀崩解成無數漂浮的碎片，重組成一個更加扭曲的存在——現實本身開始崩塌！
phase2.transform_text_en: The Void Sovereign's body dissolves into countless drifting fragments, reassembling into something far more twisted — reality itself begins to collapse!
